name: email-builder
description: Framework-agnostic drag-and-drop email builder for React and Vue 3.
author: Anshuman Kumar Kushwaha

scripts.build: npm run build -w @email-builder/core && npm run build -w @email-builder/engine && npm run build -w @email-builder/styles && npm run build -w @email-builder/react && npm run build -w @email-builder/vue
scripts.test: npm run test -w @email-builder/core && npm run test -w @email-builder/engine
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/engine && tsc --noEmit -p packages/react && vue-tsc --noEmit -p packages/vue
scripts.release:check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm pack --dry-run -w @email-builder/core -w @email-builder/engine -w @email-builder/styles -w @email-builder/react -w @email-builder/vue
scripts.release: npm run release:check && npm publish -w @email-builder/core -w @email-builder/engine -w @email-builder/styles -w @email-builder/react -w @email-builder/vue --access public
